content.tagline: Dermocosmetics for age-specific skin concerns, from breakouts to enlarged pores
content.descriptor: CELLAHEAL (ESTC INTERNATIONAL, Korea) — 9 SKUs in the current export price list: the SPOTLESS line for breakout-prone skin and the PORELESS line for enlarged pores
about: CELLAHEAL is a dermocosmetic brand by the Korean company ESTC INTERNATIONAL (CEO Gun Kim), founded in 2024. Per the brand's own strategy, it is built around age-specific skin concerns: the SPOTLESS line for breakout-prone young skin (10–20s), the PORELESS line for enlarged pores (20–30s), and a stated TIMELESS line for signs of aging (30–40s, launch stated for March 2027 — not yet released products). The brand's idea: a customer who once solved their first skin concern with CELLAHEAL returns to the brand when the next concern appears.

The current export price list lists 9 SKUs. SPOTLESS (for breakout-prone skin): body wash, body mist, body lotion, cleansing foam, toner and serum, built on Salvia Leaf Water and a four-acid exfoliating system (AHA · BHA · PHA · LHA). PORELESS (for enlarged pores and excess sebum): gel cleanser, serum and cream, built on the proprietary PORE LASER™ complex (10,000 ppm) and apricot-derived PDRN.

Per the brand: products completed dermatologist and sensitive-skin tests (25 participants per test), acne-prone/breakout-prone skin care claims were filed with Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS), and the body wash formula is protected by Korean patent No. KR 10-2991658. The full line is registered under EU CPNP; select SKUs also carry FDA MoCRA (US).

lines.name: SPOTLESS LINE
lines.note: For breakout-prone skin (the brand's target audience: 10–20s): body wash, body mist, body lotion, cleansing foam, toner and serum, built on Salvia Leaf Water and the 4HA exfoliating system (AHA · BHA · PHA · LHA).

lines.name: PORELESS LINE
lines.note: For enlarged pores and excess sebum (the brand's target audience: 20–30s): gel cleanser, serum and cream built on the PORE LASER™ complex (10,000 ppm) and apricot-derived PDRN.

lines.name: TIMELESS LINE
lines.note: A stated brand line for signs of aging (target audience: 30–40s); launch stated for March 2027 — not yet released products.

tech.name: SPOTLESS COMPLEX™
tech.note: A proprietary complex of apple and birch bark extracts and ferments (Saccharomyces/Coix Seed Ferment Filtrate, Lactobacillus/Pomegranate Ferment Extract); per the brand, it supports hydration and skin conditioning after cleansing across the whole SPOTLESS line.

tech.name: PORE LASER™
tech.note: A proprietary 10,000 ppm complex of green tea, yuzu, neem and white water lily extracts; per the brand, it is formulated for pore and sebum care in the PORELESS line.

tech.name: 4HA System
tech.note: Multi-level exfoliation with AHA, BHA, PHA and LHA, used across all six SPOTLESS-line SKUs.

catalog_notes: A body wash for breakout-prone skin: the 4HA exfoliating system (AHA · BHA · PHA · LHA), 26.4% Salvia Leaf Water and the proprietary SPOTLESS COMPLEX™ for post-cleanse hydration. Formula patent KR 10-2991658 (per the brand). 500 mL.
A light, alcohol-free body mist with 44.1% Salvia Leaf Water, 2% niacinamide and a 10-type hyaluronic acid system, for daily body tone and hydration care. 150 mL.
A fast-absorbing body lotion that closes out the SPOTLESS body routine: 40% Salvia Leaf Water, 2% niacinamide and an 8-type hyaluronic acid complex with panthenol. 300 mL.
A cleansing foam for breakout-prone skin with 0.5% salicylic acid; per the brand, tested fine-dust removal of 99.4% after a single use. 150 mL.
A watery facial toner with 43.12% Salvia Leaf Water, 2% niacinamide and multi-acid exfoliation — the hydration and tone-care step of the SPOTLESS routine. 200 mL.
An intensive serum closing out the SPOTLESS facial routine: 56.35% Salvia Leaf Water, 2% niacinamide, 2% panthenol and a ceramide complex for the skin barrier. 30 mL.
A gel-to-foam cleanser for pores and excess sebum with the PORE LASER™ complex (10,000 ppm), apricot-derived PDRN and fine apricot seed powder for gentle exfoliation. 150 mL.
A dual-function serum with PORE LASER™ (10,000 ppm), 2% niacinamide, 400 ppm adenosine, apricot-derived PDRN and a 17-amino-acid complex. 50 mL.
A cream with PORE LASER™ (10,000 ppm), 2% niacinamide, apricot-derived PDRN and the SLLS complex for barrier support. 60 mL.
